import os,subprocess,tempfile,zipfile,io,json,hashlib,datetime,shutil
repo=r'E:\WebAIBridge'
sha='18a286d4522dd73b5a65d88b5823053b71b01569'
report={'at':datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds'),'target':sha,'production_head_before':'','production_head_after':'','shadow_only':True,'tests':[]}
def git(*args,timeout=9):
 return subprocess.run(['git.exe','-C',repo,*args],capture_output=True,timeout=timeout)
p=git('rev-parse','HEAD')
report['production_head_before']=p.stdout.decode(errors='replace').strip()
original=git('status','--porcelain=v1','-z','--untracked-files=all')
report['porcelain_before_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(original.stdout).hexdigest()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='wab-r45-shadow-') as folder:
 archive=git('archive','--format=zip',sha,timeout=18)
 report['archive_code']=archive.returncode
 if archive.returncode==0:
  with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(archive.stdout)) as z:z.extractall(folder)
  app=os.path.join(folder,'app')
  for argv in (['node.exe','--check','server.js'],['node.exe','--test','managed-chat-inspection-r45.test.js'],['node.exe','--test','operational-health.test.js']):
   try:
    p=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=app,capture_output=True,timeout=15)
    report['tests'].append({'argv':argv,'code':p.returncode,'stdoutTail':p.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')[-500:],'stderrTail':p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')[-350:]})
   except Exception as e:report['tests'].append({'argv':argv,'error':type(e).__name__})
report['production_head_after']=git('rev-parse','HEAD').stdout.decode(errors='replace').strip()
report['porcelain_after_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(git('status','--porcelain=v1','-z','--untracked-files=all').stdout).hexdigest()
report['production_unchanged']=report['production_head_before']==report['production_head_after'] and report['porcelain_before_sha256']==report['porcelain_after_sha256']
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=True)[:7200])
